title: A Typewriter for the Ledger
author: Wendell Zhou
blurb: Gideon Ishikawa, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
